newsitem.title: JAPAN: All months of Tokyo corn futures end higher.
newsitem.headline: All months of Tokyo corn futures end higher.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher on Wednesday, following Tuesday's price plunges, as active technical buying from local investors emerged, traders said.
Prices were 140 to 360 yen up, and the benchmark January 1998 contract was up 150 yen at 14,370 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 60,924 lots.
Local investors were active technical buyers from the opening, traders said. The yen's losses against the dollar also encouraged buying, they said.
"But the investors are becoming quieter ahead of New Year holidays," a brokerage house trader said.
